description: Suchbegriffe und Empfehlungen für PolyHaven-Assets passend zur Spielästhetik (Gothic / Ruinen / Ritual)

suggestions.notes: Dekor: stone gargoyle, good for roofs and corners
arches and doorways for level dressing
hero prop for ritual sites, higher poly/texture budgets
small prop, emissive texture for lights
tower bell prop, good for audio sync visuals
grouped candles for altar props, use emissive maps
floor tiles with variation for roads and moss overlays

usage_notes: Use the queries above on polyhaven.com or the API. Prefer OBJ/FBX/GLTF with textures; choose 2K-4K based on budget. Extract and place each asset in its own folder under tools/blender-mcp/input/ before running the Blender exporter.
